questions.q:
A cab driver received ratings from 10 customers on a given day, which are:

$$7, 8, 6, 9, 7, 5, 8, 9, 8, x$$

If the relative frequency of rating 9 is 0.30. Find the value of $x$.

|---|---|---|---|
| Online | 40 | 20 | 60 |
| Offline | 20 | 40 | 60 |

Is mode of learning associated with the year of study?

No

questions.q: A sales team of 30 members has an average monthly sales of ₹60,000. The top 10 performers have an average of ₹90,000, while the bottom 10 performers have an average of ₹30,000. What is the average monthly sales of the middle 10 performers?
If addition and subtraction are meaningful operation for a variable, then the scale(s) of measurement of the variable could be:
options: Ratio
Nominal
Ordinal
Interval

questions.q: Which of the following statements correctly describe Descriptive and Inferential Statistics?
options: Descriptive statistics uses probability theory to draw conclusions, while inferential statistics is represented through tables, charts, and graphs.
Inferential statistics involves using sample data to make generalizations or predictions about a population.
Both descriptive and inferential statistics only deal with numerical data, not categorical data.
Descriptive statistics involves summarizing data using measures such as mean, median, and standard deviation.
Cross-sectional data are collected at a single point in time across several individuals, firms, or regions etc.
Time series data involve observations on a variable measured at a single point of time.
Nominal scale provides both labelling and meaningful ranking of categories.
Ratio scale has an absolute zero and allows for comparison of both differences and ratios between observations.

questions.q:
A company studied the relationship between advertising expenditure ($X$) and sales revenue ($Y$) across 12 months. The following summary statistics were calculated:

|  | $X$ | $Y$ |
|---|---|---|
| Arithmetic mean | 8 | 60 |
| Sum of squares of deviation from mean | 100 | 400 |

Also, sum of product of deviation of $X$ and $Y$ from respective means is 160. Using the information, compute the correlation coefficient between advertising expenditure and sales revenue. Enter the answer correct to one decimal place.

Table 4 represents the responses of the students of their preferred movie type.

| Movie Type | Frequency | Relative Frequency |
|---|---|---|
| Action | 36 | 0.30 |
| Comedy | $a$ | 0.25 |
| Drama | $b$ | 0.20 |
| Horror | $c$ | $d$ |
| Others | $e$ | 0.10 |

Find the value of $a + b + c$.

Table 3 displays the data recorded by an ice-cream vendor, showing the outdoor temperature (°C) and the number of ice creams sold on four different days.

| Day | Temperature ($X$) | Ice-creams Sold ($Y$) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 20 | 30 |
| 2 | 25 | 55 |
| 3 | 30 | 70 |
| 4 | 45 | 85 |

Calculate the population covariance between temperature and ice-creams sold.

A startup recorded the daily step counts (in thousands) of 8 users:

$$8, 17, 15, 19, 21, 25, 23, 35$$

To spot unusually active users, the startup sets a threshold defined as:

$$\text{Threshold} = Q_3 + 1.5 \times IQR$$

Any user whose step count is above this threshold will be marked as an outlier. How many users will be marked as outliers?
There are 4 observations whose mean is 5 and population variance is 2.5. Two of the observations are known to be 4 and 6. Find the product of the remaining two observations.

questions.context:
A logistics company tracks the daily number of parcels delivered by two of its branches over a period of 5 days.

- Branch A shows an average of 36 deliveries per day with a standard deviation of 0.
- Branch B also has an average of 36 deliveries per day, but with a standard deviation of 8.
options: Since both branches have the same average, their performance is equally consistent.
Branch A is more consistent than Branch B because its standard deviation is lower.
Branch A delivers exactly 36 parcels every day, while Branch B’s daily deliveries fluctuate around 36.
Consistency should be evaluated only on the basis of the mean.
